utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll see where I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can take the parts that are still open. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for jumping in. The remaining pieces are the fixture mounts, a few screws, and cleanup once those are in place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look if you point me to the main issue.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you check the front-left wheel and the brake light first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I’ll check those first and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare tarps and gloves if the repair drive still needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, those would help a lot. Thanks, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring them by later today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we have enough trucks and boxes for everyone? I don't want people showing up and waiting around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think we do if we keep it organized. I’ll check the truck count and bring extra boxes just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs doing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there are still a few odds and ends left, but I’m not sure which ones yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are the odds and ends still left?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up this afternoon. Folks are saying the hardware store donated a pile of tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now, Opal. If you want to help with the repair drive, I can connect you with the folks organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll ask them to send the details your way so you can jump in right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what you want me to check on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d like you to check the drive connections, any loose parts, and whether the motor is running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Morning, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, so let’s go through what’s still needed and who can take each piece.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Morning, Rosa. I can help with the list, but I’ll need the items one by one since I’m skimming today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure thing, Bo. First item: the porch rail needs lumber and two volunteers with drills; can you take that one?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: we’ll meet at nine by the side gate and go over the list together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll be there at nine by the side gate, and we can go over the list together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I was just about to ask if there’s a list I should be helping with.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, if you’ve got the list, point me to it and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I can help round up people for the repair drive if that makes things easier.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be a huge help, Jules. I can start putting names together while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll keep lining people up and check in with you if I hear of anyone handy with tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by the repair drive, Dane — we’re getting a good crew together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can swing by, even if I’m a little late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, see you there — even a late arrival helps if you bring that good energy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just a few steady hands and a couple of strong backs would help. If you can come by Saturday morning, I’ll have a clear list ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday morning works for me. I’ll come by ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to make sure it doesn't conflict with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps. We can keep you on pickup duty for the early shift and I’ll cover the later calls so it stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, thanks. I’ll handle the early pickup shift.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the repair drive is a good one. I can help spread the word and see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules. I’ll keep spreading the word and I’ll check in with whoever still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, thanks for teaming up on it. I’ll keep nudging my side of the neighborhood too and point anyone I hear from your way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring my drill and a few spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks. I’ll make a list of what else we need and check if we have enough extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll check our cords and bring any extra power strips I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the locations. Where should we start with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s begin with the first address you need repaired, and I’ll keep the list organized from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does it start, and do I need to bring tools or just materials?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can swing by and help with the repair drive. Just tell me what needs doing next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then I need someone to check the tool box and sort the fasteners by size before we start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the toolbox and sort the fasteners by size now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive got moved around a bit. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Last I heard, it’s still on for this weekend, just at the new spot near the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive is actually happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s happening today. I heard they’re starting pretty soon, so people are already heading over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So they’re really starting today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I just heard the repair drive is getting people moving, so I’m keeping an eye out for what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can lend a hand with the lighter jobs, but I may need to take it slow today.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That helps a lot, Uli. I’ll keep the slower tasks in mind and flag anything that needs a steadier hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I was meaning to bring something by for that, but I’ve been a bit scattered—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can still use a hand with just about anything, honestly, but I can definitely bring over some tools or help sort parts if that’s useful.
